confidence_note: every number is quoted from Cloudflare's Workers Builds limits page and the build documentation; no build was run, so network access from the build container and the behaviour once Free minutes are spent are unverified

free_tier.stated: Workers Free: 3,000 build minutes a month, 1 concurrent build, 20 minutes per build, 2 vCPU, 8 GB memory and 20 GB disk. Workers Paid (USD 5 a month minimum): 6,000 build minutes a month, then USD 0.005 per minute, 6 concurrent builds, 4 vCPU
free_tier.notes: a build minute is the time a project takes to build; the overage price applies on Paid plans only

per_object_cap.stated: 20 minutes per build on every plan; 8 GB memory and 20 GB disk per build; 64 environment variables per Worker

retention.stated: builds and build logs are kept 90 days after the build finishes; the versions and deployments a build created are not removed

egress.terms: not stated for the build container; the build's output is a Worker, and the Workers Paid plan states no additional charge for data transfer (egress) or bandwidth

interface_detail: a push to a connected GitHub, GitLab, Cursor Origin or Cloudflare Artifacts repository runs an optional build command, then a deploy command that defaults to npx wrangler deploy and can be customised; non-production branches run a preview command. A Deploy Hook is a URL that starts a build for one branch on an HTTP POST with no Authorization header
tooling: an Ubuntu 24.04 build image with Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby and Go preinstalled and versions overridable by environment variable or version file; the deploy and preview commands are Wrangler commands
chaining: a 20-minute Ubuntu job on every push or Deploy Hook call, ending in a Worker deploy; an external cron calling a Deploy Hook makes it a scheduled job, and a repository on Cloudflare Artifacts keeps source, build and deploy inside one Cloudflare account. GitHub Actions on a public repository gives longer jobs and comes first

limits.value: 20 minutes per build on Free and Paid; 8 GB memory; 20 GB disk
3,000 build minutes a month on Free; 6,000 on Paid, then USD 0.005 per minute
1 concurrent build per account on Free, 6 on Paid; Deploy Hooks 10 a minute per Worker and 100 a minute per account
builds and build logs kept 90 days after the build finishes

limits_note: a build fails when the Worker name in the dashboard does not match the name in the Wrangler configuration file; Workers Builds does not honour the custom-build settings of the Wrangler file
binding_note: a job longer than 20 minutes cannot run on any plan, and the 3,000 Free minutes at one concurrent build hold many full-length builds, so the per-build cap fails before the monthly minutes

identity_cost.detail: a Cloudflare account opened with an email address and a password, then verified by email; a GitHub, GitLab or Cursor Origin account authorised to Cloudflare, unless the repository is on Cloudflare Artifacts. Workers Paid adds a USD 5 monthly minimum charge

reliability_note: only GitHub, GitLab, Cursor Origin and Cloudflare Artifacts repositories connect; GitHub or GitLab instances run by their owners do not
